text: Ah, the new cadet! Come, come. Sit down.
Good evening. Sorry, am I late?
A little! Dinner is from seventeen thirty to eighteen fifteen. But I kept a plate for you. Chicken adobo.
Thank you very much. What time is breakfast?
Breakfast is from zero seven thirty to zero eight fifteen.
Seven and a half?
Zero seven thirty, cadet! On board we use the twenty-four-hour clock.
Zero seven thirty. Got it. And lunch?
Lunch is at eleven thirty. And coffee break is at ten hundred and fifteen hundred.
Could you pass the salt, please?
Here you are.
And if you're on watch at dinner time, tell me. I keep a plate for you.
Thanks, Mario. Can I have some more rice?
Of course! And all the times are on the notice board, next to the door.
When is breakfast? Show me.
Show me lunch.
Where's dinner?
Show me the coffee break.
I'm on watch from twelve hundred to sixteen hundred. Show me.
Show me when I'm off duty.
Hey cadet, what time is lunch?
Everything OK, cadet? You need anything?
Diego, what time is it?
Dinner is at seventeen thirty. You come?
Today coffee break is at fifteen thirty.
The pilot comes at thirteen hundred.
